_doc: What is installed in Assetto Corsa on the PC, folder by folder: the record tools/ac_tidy.py classifies content/tracks against (Kevin 2026-11-06: 'we need a routine on the PC that keeps AC clean and up-to-date').

role: current (the build Kevin last installed for that track) | kept (an older copy Kevin chose to keep beside its successor) | superseded (an older copy whose successor is installed: the tidy plan moves it on Kevin's yes) | k10-era (a k10 build with a doooom successor).
branch: where the track's next build lands; ac_tidy flags 'newer' when tracks/<track>/track.config.json there has a higher version than installed (an offer: installs stay on Kevin's word).
After every install: python tools/ac_tidy.py record <folder> --track <track> --branch <branch> --sha <sha> [--engine lm-v4], then commit this file with the install records.
Folders not listed here and not ours (no doooom / airoso / k10 author or name) are Kunos and third-party tracks: never touched.
